text:
alex: Quick flag from today's canary run of yokohama-v1-q5 (mixed-orient subset). We're seeing fused tokens when Japanese vertical lines include inline Arabic captions. chrF dropped ~1.4 on that slice.
riko: can you paste an example?
alex: sample: vertical block: 
漢字(かんじ)
caption: البدا
combined serialized: VERT_START漢字(RUBY)嵐
CAP: البدا
expected detok: "Kanji (kanji) ... Caption: al-bada"
observed detok: "Kanji(かんじ)البدا" (ruby stuck to Arabic)
omar: which tokenizer/normalization? fast-tokenizer v3 + nfkc + ruby-optimizer on q5 path?
alex: yes fast-v3, ruby-optimizer enabled. repro used --tokenizer-debug true.
eval-bot: metrics short: BLEU 33.8->32.4, chrF 0.645->0.631, token-boundary anomalies +1.2%
riko: sounds like the ruby coalesce step isn't inserting a bidi reset. fast-v3's optimization may coalesce across script boundaries.
omar: short mitigation: disable ruby-optimizer in canary tokenizers (feature-flag), rerun smoke. Can someone flip?
alex: deploy-bot: disable ruby_optim=true on yokohama-v1-q5 canary pool?
deploy-bot: Ack. Toggling ruby_optim=false in canary tokenizer config. Changes will rollout in ~90s. :gear:
riko: once rolled, please re-run repro and attach tokenized boundary dump. If fixed, add unit test: tests/tokenizer_unit/test_vertical_ruby_rtl.py and add onboarding gate: "vertical+rtl smoke".
alex: assigning: riko (repro + test), omar (audit tokenizer coalesce), alex (ticket + canary verification). tagging @eng-ml.
